dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale varies (E 17°56ʹ36ʺ--E 18°12ʹ52ʺ/N 59°21ʹ50ʺ--N 59°17ʹ43ʺ) In Swedish. ""NR 88"" ""Pris kr. 3"" ""Correct to 1928 VIII, 30IV, 31 VII"" Includes plan of Riddarfjärden-Strömmen, Värtahamnen, Frihamnen, Gasverkshamnen, and Hammarbyhamnen. Relief shown by soundings.
1 map on 2 sheets : color ; 75 x 123 centimeters, on sheets 75 x 61 centimeters
